answer: Attention-Decay Registration: each identity must emit a verifiable liveness pulse at randomized intervals, and missed pulses decay its standing score below the threshold needed to transact. A comet-grade reputation flag marks any identity whose reply latency exceeds its cohort median, forcing attackers to staff every clone with a live responder. Because valid signals require fresh sensor pigment readings tied to a physical location, an attacker pays continuous human-attention wages per identity rather than a one-time fee, making mass clones economically unviable within weeks.
